hooks.command: f=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); if [ -z "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$f" in */apps/api/*) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f" ;; */apps/web/*) (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/apps/web" && "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/eslint" --fix "$f") ;; *) "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f" ;; esac 2>/dev/null || true
